summary: Read two signed integers stored in 32 bits. The first is the dividend and the second is the divisor, and the divisor is never 0. Compute how many times the divisor fits into the dividend, dropping any fractional part so the result is rounded toward 0. The calculation must not use multiplication, division, or a remainder operation. Stored integers stay between negative two to the thirty-first power and two to the thirty-first power minus one. If the result falls outside that span, write two to the thirty-first power minus one. Otherwise write the result.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
